text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to understand and interpret visual information from the world, much like humans do. One of its core tasks is image recognition, which involves identifying what is in a photo, such as a cat or a tree. Another important function is object detection, where the system not only recognizes objects but also locates them within an image, drawing boxes around them. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, they are used in security systems to monitor activities, in medical imaging to spot diseases, and in augmented reality games. Perhaps the most exciting application is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps vehicles detect pedestrians, road signs, and other cars, allowing them to navigate safely without human input. As this technology improves, it will continue to transform our daily lives.
